description: Tainwala Chemicals and Plastics (India) Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of extruded plastic sheets in India. The company operates in two segments, Plastic Sheets and Tradable Items. It also offers PVC rigid, flexible, and corrugated sheets, as well as PVC foils; and polypropylene, talc-filled polypropylene, glass-fabric laminated polypropylene, polyethylene, polystyrene, acrylontrile, and polypropylene copolymer sheets. The company is also involved in commodity and share trading business. In addition, its products are used in the fabrication of industrial equipment; the lining of chemical tanks; signboards; automobiles; and white goods industry as well as pollution control equipment. Further, the company serves engineering and construction, affluent treatment, automobiles, ancillary, railway, chemical plant manufacturing, humanitarian, and other industries. Tainwala Chemicals and Plastics (India) Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Mumbai, India.
